reviews.comment: Don't miss homework, attempt whatever you have in mind just don't leave it blank; complete your in class quizzes which are extremely easy, and do a decent work on exams. Nothing to fear.

Pretty bad professor- I took 0 information from the class after taking it the entire semester. Homeworks are alright, tests are also alright, but you don't learn anything. So in reality, the class itself is hard, especially if you don't self-study. I pity the people taking him in the future.

Nice guy, poor prof. Won't post slides and spends class drawing all over them. 320 had a MATLAB component that wasn't taught well and you had to scour the book to understand even a little. Only 2 exams, I aced the 1st & failed the 2nd because we were given little hw so didn't even know how to practice/study. Note: 1/2way through switched to online
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Pop quizzes are super simple. HW is super hard and time consuming, but your tests are a whole lot easier than the HW. His lectures are straight from the textbook - this required a lot of extra work outside of class to teach myself. However, as long as you put in the work, youll get a good grade. Not the worst prof but not the best prof
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The worst professor I have ever had. Some of the material on the second exam was not even covered at all! Lectures do not at all prepare you for the homework. Every time someone hands in homework a minute late, he goes on this long speech on how it is good to get partial credit than nothing at all, gets annoying.  Hoping for a good curve. Avoid him
He isn't a nice person, and he doesn't like students. His class presentations are unorganized, and his powerpoint presentations are blurry and impossible to read.

He doesn't teach well, and he doesn't explain the material. The slides in his class presentations are unreadable, and most of the material on the exams isn't covered in class. He is a mean person, and he doesn't care about students.
